name: jetpack-compose-performance

summary.en: Google’s Android skill for diagnosing Compose performance problems such as excess recomposition and dropped frames.
summary.zh: Google 官方 Android Skill，用于诊断 Compose 的性能问题，例如过度重组和掉帧。

upstreamDescription: Diagnose and optimize Android Jetpack Compose UI code. Use this skill when analyzing performance bottlenecks of existing code to minimize recomposition overhead and prevent dropped frames and UI lag.
